text:
liam: Quick q for infra/product — Equinox (legal name: Equinox Health) wants to run a private deployment of an open model. They asked specifically about onboarding a quantized variant we don't have in the catalog yet: `equinox-13b-v2-int8`. Main asks: 1) is this variant compatible with Dedicated + Private runtime? 2) does KV cache persist across node restarts for private install? 3) rough delta on pricing for reserved capacity for an int8 variant vs standard fp16? cc @sophia @maya

sophia: short answer: probably yes but with caveats. int8 needs kernel/quantization pass support in our runtime. we should run a variant compatibility scan (weights + config). also need to validate attention kernel fallback for longer seqs.

maya: I can take the onboarding. next steps: get model weights URL, model config (hf or local), and an example 1k-token workload to profile. I'll run a quick perf sweep on an A100-80GB in Dedicated env.

liam: equinox sent a link to the artifact (S3 presigned) and their perf target: p95 latency <= 220ms for 1k tokens, throughput ~ 12 reqs/s. they also asked whether we support disk-backed kv cache (so restarts don't invalidate caches).

zara-eng: disk-backed KV cache exists as an opt-in feature in private deploys. it serializes shards to local disk and reloads on process start. current caveats: checkpoint format must match runtime version and we don't have cross-node shared cache, only per-node.

samir: security note — enterprise wants to see encryption at rest + KMS integration, and a completed security questionnaire. also need a data flow diagram showing where model artifacts and logs go. please send SSO/SAML docs and our SOC2 link.

liam: will ping them for the SQ + S3 ACLs. can you point to a template, @samir?

samir: use the standard enterprise pack: https://intranet.redwood/sec/enterprise-pack (they can upload back). for SAML + KMS we need their IDP metadata and KMS key ARN.

maya: perf notes — for int8 on A100 we see 10-20% speedups but token quality can vary; recommend running a small eval to compare logits/outputs vs fp16. also need to test KV cache warmup behavior because our batching logic interacts with cached prefixes.

liam: pricing ask from their procurement: what's the committed monthly cost delta if they reserve a Dedicated pool tuned for int8 workloads? they want a ballpark to feed CFO.

maya: rough ballpark: reserved capacity pricing is driven by GPU hours and model memory footprint. int8 reduces memory allowing 1.2-1.5x higher concurrency on same instance class — so per-token cost down ~15-30%, but list price for a reserved slot is similar. I'll ask pricing to run a modeled delta with projected QPS.

zara-eng: next operational blocker: variant naming. if we onboard `equinox-13b-v2-int8` we should register it as a variant of `equinox-13b-v2` with metadata: quantization=int8, validated_kernels=[cuda_attn_v2, fused_ffn]. suggest we add a compatibility tag `private-ready` once scans pass.

liam: good. timeline? Equinox wants to start a 2-week pilot next Wed.

maya: timeline: 1) today: get artifacts + security packet from Equinox (liam) 2) days 1-2: run compatibility scan + quick eval (me) 3) days 3-4: perf runs on A100, KV cache restart tests (zara) 4) day 5: pricing calc + handoff to solutions. ETA 5 business days, PR/notes to sales thread.

samir: I'll prep the compliance checklist and mark any blockers. if model has any third-party licensed weights we need legal review.

liam: thanks all. I'll chase the SQ and S3 access now and update thread. devops-bot: please create an onboarding ticket for this flow.

devops-bot: created ticket #ONB-1472 — "equinox-13b-v2-int8 onboard"; assigned to maya, zara-eng.

maya: assigned, picking this up. will post perf artifacts and a short rollout playbook here when ready.

liam: perfect — keep this thread updated, and FYI procurement asked if we can quote early with an "indicative price" (non-binding). maya/sophia, can you draft a short indicative number after perf run?

sophia: yes, will do after perf numbers in ~72h. :thumbsup:
